what: Two test-only preliminary verification reads and pause points before authoritative transactions. All callers can read the same starting snapshot without holding Firestore locks; release one at a time proves each transaction re-reads the current resend reservation or attempt budget. Gated controls replace that authoritative read with the stale preliminary snapshot to reintroduce S22/S23. No side effects happen at the gates, and the helper fails closed when the gate service is unavailable.
